subject.title: AI safety taxonomy: UI/CLI observability surfaces

question: Should this operator experience be a first-class core view over the existing generic diagnostics and security event contract, or should core expose only generic APIs while a plugin owns the safety-specific CLI and dashboard?
rationale: The issue adds a core CLI namespace, Gateway RPCs, UI navigation, storage and retention behavior, and security-sensitive metadata policy; current architecture supports multiple valid ownership models, so maintainer intent is required.

options.title: Core generic diagnostics view
options.body: Extend the existing diagnostic contract and add a core CLI and UI view with strict authorization, SQLite retention, pagination, aggregates, and bounded fields.

options.title: Plugin-owned safety experience
options.body: Add only missing generic diagnostic query or storage SDK seams in core and ship taxonomy-specific commands and dashboards as a plugin.

options.title: Defer the program
options.body: Pause this child issue and its PR until the parent schema and exporter issues receive explicit maintainer sponsorship and security approval.

recommendation.title: Core generic diagnostics view
recommendation.body: Extend the existing diagnostic contract and add a core CLI and UI view with strict authorization, SQLite retention, pagination, aggregates, and bounded fields.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history shows the broadest involvement across Gateway, diagnostics, and Control UI decision surfaces.
